description: STATEHOUSE (March 21, 2016) – Today, Gov. Mike Pence signed legislation sponsored by State Rep. Wendy McNamara (R-Evansville) to help combat drug abuse. Senate Enrolled Act (SEA) 187 could help reduce fatal drug overdoses by permitting pharmacies to sell overdose intervention drugs, like Narcan, over-the-counter without a prescription. title: McNamara: Bills Combating Drug Abuse Signed into Law - Wendy McNamara
